tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250thugs sgrub dzap kyi bkol byang ltar rigs drug dong sprug gi dmigs pa zur phyung ni/1$0000300

'gro 'dul 'phags pa la bsten nas: gzhan don rigs drug dong sprug gi: ting 'dzin rim pa 'di ltar brtag: 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng: dbus su hrīḥyig dkar 'tsher 'od 'bar zhing: 'dab ma drug la yig drug sngags kyis mtshan: rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs dzap kyis bskul ba'i mthus: hūm̐ las me long ye shes ngo bo nyid: 'od zer mthing nag dmyal ba'i yul du 'phros: zhe sdang las byung tsha grang sdug bsngal sbyangs: snod bcud rdo rje 'phags pa'i zhing du gyur: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: me las mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid: 'od zer ser po yi dwags yul du 'phros: ser sna las gyur bkres skom sdug bsngal sbyangs: snod bcud rin chen 'phags pa'i zhing du gyur: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: pad las chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid: 'od zer dkar po dud 'gro'i yul du 'phros: gti mug las byung glen lkug sdug bsngal sbyangs: snod bcud bde gshegs 'phags pa'i zhing du gyur: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: ṇi las sor rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid: 'od zer dmar po mi yi yul du 'phros: 'dod chags las byung brel 'phong sdug bsngal sbyangs: snod bcud pad+ma 'phags pa'i zhing du gyur: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: ma las bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid: 'od zer ljang gu lha min yul du 'phros: phrag dog las byung 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal sbyangs: snod bcud las kyi 'phags pa'i zhing du gyur: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: oṃ las 'od gsal ye shes ngo bo nyid: 'od zer dkar 'tsher lha yi yul du 'phros: nga rgyal las byung 'pho ltung sdug bsngal sbyangs: snod bcud rigs 'dus 'phags pa'i zhing du gyur: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: hrīḥlas dbyer med ye shes ngo bo nyid: 'od zer dpag yas nam mkha' khyab par 'phros: mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i las nyon sdug bsngal sbyangs:

kun kyang 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i zhing du gyur: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: snang ba thams cad thugs rje chen po'i sku: sgrar grags yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyi dbyangs: dran rtog stong nyid snying rje dbyer med ngang: 'khor ba dong sprugs phrin las mthar phyin gyur: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: de ltar rtse gcig nyams blangs pas: bye ba gcig gis las kun 'grub: dngos nyams 'phags pa'i zhal mthong zhing: gzhan phan snying rje rtsol med skye: rmi lam rnag khrag mi gtsang 'bab: khrus byas gos dkar gyon pa dang: mkha' la 'phur dang chu steng bgrod: nyam nga'i gnas las 'gro mang bsgral: de sogs dge ba'i mtshan ma rnams: sgrib dag gzhan phan ltas su shes: sa ma ya: ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
